changeSet.author: bng-team
changeSet.comment: Create bng.users — one row per authenticated Defra ID user, upserted on each successful login by src/db/persist-session.js. user_id is the token `sub`.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE bng.users ( user_id text PRIMARY KEY, email text, first_name text, last_name text, created timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), last_login timestamptz, session_id text );

changeSet.author: bng-team
changeSet.comment: Create bng.relationships — the org relationships carried in a user's Defra ID token. Upserted (never deleted) on each login, keyed on (user_id, relationship_id). The named UNIQUE constraint is required so onConflictDoUpdate has a real unique index to target.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE bng.relationships ( user_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES bng.users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, relationship_id text NOT NULL, org_id text, org_name text, relationship text, last_updated timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT uq_relationships_user_rel UNIQUE (user_id, relationship_id) );

changeSet.author: bng-team
changeSet.comment: Create bng.roles — the roles (with status) carried in a user's Defra ID token. Upserted (never deleted) on each login, keyed on (user_id, relationship_id, name); removed access arrives naturally as a status update (6/7). The (user_id, relationship_id) index backs the RBAC visibility EXISTS join used by src/db/project-visibility.js.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE bng.roles ( user_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES bng.users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, relationship_id text NOT NULL, name text NOT NULL, status smallint NOT NULL, last_updated timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT uq_roles_user_rel_name UNIQUE (user_id, relationship_id, name) );
CREATE INDEX idx_roles_user_rel ON bng.roles (user_id, relationship_id);

changeSet.author: bng-team
changeSet.comment: Stamp projects with the creating user's current org context so RBAC can scope visibility to an approved relationship. Both columns are nullable: legacy rows created before Defra ID RBAC have no relationship and stay visible to their creator (user_id) only.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE bng.projects ADD COLUMN org_id text; ALTER TABLE bng.projects ADD COLUMN relationship_id text;
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE bng.projects DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS relationship_id; ALTER TABLE bng.projects DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS org_id;
